notes: Tone mapping (docs/tests only; do not rename live values): live default↔contract neutral; live good↔contract success.
Live tones: default | info | good | warning | danger. Variants: dot | badge.
Synthetic labels only; no credentials, private IDs, runtime URLs, or server payloads.

geometry.badge: h-5 pill with text; never color-only

expectedTokenGeometry: Each tone pairs a marker/badge chrome with visible text label
Never present a tone as color alone without text

r10.keyboardTouch: StatusPill is non-interactive presentation; no activation claim
r10.focus: not a focus target by default
r10.screenReader: text label always present with tone chrome (never color-only)
r10.validationBusyDisabledStatus: all live tones render with text for both variants
r10.zoom: label text remains present at component level
r10.darkLight: render under data-theme zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
r10.narrow: inline status; shared viewport labels only
